response.text: Journals 2034 and 2386 are unbalanced. Next I'll check journal 2386, the payment-to-journal tie-out, payment dates against close dates, and duplicates using normalized invoice numbers.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."INV_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (2386,2034)

SELECT p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", s.dr, s.cr FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") dr, SUM("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1) s ON s."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR s.dr<>p."PAY_AMT" OR h."POST_DT"<>p."PAY_DT"

SELECT a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID", a."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO", a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" FROM "APINVH" a JOIN "APINVH" b ON a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" AND regexp_replace(lower(a."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(b."INV_NO"),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')

SELECT a."INV_ID", b."INV_ID", a."VEND_CD", b."VEND_CD", a."INV_NO", b."INV_NO", a."INV_AMT", a."INV_DT", b."INV_DT" FROM "APINVH" a JOIN "APINVH" b ON a."INV_ID"<b."INV_ID" AND split_part(a."INV_NO",'-',2)=split_part(b."INV_NO",'-',2)
